record.paper_title: Analysis on Faddeev Knots and Skyrme Solitons: Recent Progress and Open Problems
record.original_question: Let S be the set of integers N for which the Faddeev minimization problem EN = inf{E(n) | E(n) < ∞, Q(n) = N} is known to have a solution. The paper proves that S is infinite. Is S actually equal to all of Z, meaning that every integer Hopf charge is realized by an energy minimizer?

evidence.quote: Theorem 4.3. There exists an infinite subset S of the set Z of all integers so that for any N ∈ S the problem (3.24) has a solution. Although we do not know how big the set S is or whether S = Z, we can make the above statement more precise as follows.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n: \mathbb{R}^3 \to S^2 \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ be a smooth map with $n(x) \to n_\infty$ as $|x|\to\infty$ for some fixed $n_\infty \in S^2$, so that $n$ extends to a continuous map $S^3 \to S^2$ and has a well-defined Hopf invariant $Q(n) \in \mathbb{Z}$ (where $\pi_3(S^2)\cong\mathbb{Z}$). Define the Faddeev energy
$$E(n) = \int_{\mathbb{R}^3} \Big( \sum_{j=1}^3 |\partial_j n|^2 + \tfrac{1}{2}\sum_{j,k=1}^3 |\partial_j n \wedge \partial_k n|^2 \Big)\, dx.$$
For each integer $N$, consider the topologically constrained minimization problem
$$E_N = \inf\{ E(n) : E(n) < \infty,\ Q(n) = N \}.$$
Let $S \subset \mathbb{Z}$ be the set of integers $N$ for which this infimum is attained by some admissible $n$. It is known that $S$ is infinite. Determine whether $S = \mathbb{Z}$; that is, is every integer Hopf charge realized by a Faddeev energy minimizer?
artifact.status_search_result: Available literature on the Faddeev model in $\mathbb{R}^3$ states existence of minimizers only for an infinite subset of integer Hopf charges, with the case of a bounded domain handled for all integers. No source found establishes that minimizers exist for every Hopf charge in the full-space problem, so the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Existence of Energy Minimizers as Stable Knotted Solitons in the Faddeev Model
status_evidence.snippet: Existence holds for an infinite subset of integer Hopf charges in the full space; for bounded domains existence holds for all integers.
status_evidence.claim: Full-space existence only known on an infinite subset of Z, not all of Z.

status_evidence.title: Static knot energy, Hopf charge, and universal growth law
status_evidence.snippet: Sublinear inequality E ≤ C|Q|^{3/4} explains preference for clustered knotted configurations.
status_evidence.claim: Sublinear growth law is the basis for the partial existence result, but does not yield existence for every N.
